purpose: Route an agent through deterministic design navigation, diagnostics, structural editing, trace, handoff, and verification without semantic inference or command execution.

diagnose-state2.description: Review State 2 authoring diagnostics with structural context.

diagnose-state3.description: Review State 3 module structure and addressability diagnostics.

edit-fragment.description: Apply one addressable Markdown fragment edit through dry-run, review, atomic apply, and verification.

inspect-item.description: Inspect one indexed design item, its explicit references, and selective local context.

inspect-module.description: Inspect one stable State 3 module artifact by module:<name> key.

inventory.description: Orient in one design state using the indexed decision inventory.

state3-handoff.description: Emit stable State 3 module/capability keys enriched with authoritative State 2 ownership trace.

trace-state2-to-state3.description: Validate explicit State 2 ownership/disposition coverage in the State 3 trace manifest.

trace-term.description: Run the required broad-to-narrow navigation loop before proposing ownership or responsibility.

verify.description: Verify design structure, State 2 authoring diagnostics, and repository tests after an accepted edit.

verify-state3.description: Verify State 3 structure, State 2->3 trace closure, enriched handoff, and repository tests.

broad_mentions.why: Expand before narrowing so relevant evidence outside indexed State 2 items is not hidden.
stop_if: the design index cannot be built

candidate_references.why: Explicit references are stronger navigation evidence than lexical overlap.

editor_apply.why: Apply the already reviewed byte-preserving plan atomically.
requires: operator reviewed the complete unified diff
stop_if: the addressed item or section changed since dry-run

editor_dry_run.why: Plan one structural splice and expose the complete unified diff without changing the document.
stop_if: item or section addressing is unknown or ambiguous
the design index contains duplicate keys

get_item.why: Resolve the item structurally before inspecting or editing it.
stop_if: the item is unknown or ambiguous

item_references.why: Show explicit incoming and outgoing design relations without inferring new ones.
stop_if: the item is unknown or ambiguous

lint_state2.why: Return deterministic State 2 authoring findings with structural blast context.

list_items.why: Start from the indexed inventory instead of broad repository search.
stop_if: the design index cannot be built
duplicate item keys make addressing unsafe

narrow_mentions.why: Return from broad discovery to normative indexed evidence.
stop_if: the design index cannot be built

operator_judgment.why: Ownership and responsibility are semantic decisions and must not be inferred by the router.
stop_if: evidence is contradictory or ownership remains uncertain

rebuild_index.why: Prove that structural addressing remains valid after the edit.

review_diff.why: The operator must accept the exact addressed mutation before --apply is allowed.
stop_if: the diff changes text outside the intended fragment
the content introduces an unreviewed semantic decision

review_findings.why: Warnings are review prompts; the operator classifies them instead of the router inventing semantics.
requires: lint or trace report with diagnostic context
stop_if: a new warning indicates an unintended design change

run_tests.why: Verify the repository toolchain after structural and authoring checks pass.

selective_context.why: Inspect only source locations that may change ownership, dependencies, constraints, or the edit decision.
requires: a source path and line from a previous index result

state3_get.why: Resolve one State 3 module through its stable module:<name> address rather than reparsing prose.
requires: stable module key or module name
stop_if: the module is unknown or duplicated

state3_inventory.why: List State 3 modules as stable addressable artifacts.

state3_lint.why: Check module addressability, required responsibility sections, and stable candidate capability extraction.

trace_2_3_check.why: Validate that every State 2 decision has exactly one State 3 primary owner or an explicit non-runtime disposition.

trace_2_3_handoff.why: Emit one authoritative machine-readable handoff containing module keys, capability keys, and backward State 2 ownership/disposition trace.

global_stop_conditions: semantic content has not been supplied or accepted by the operator
the requested mutation is rename, move, delete, or another unsupported editor operation
item, module, or section addressing is ambiguous
duplicate item or module keys exist
a command would target files outside the selected project
